faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR IARI Project Associate -I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the ICAR IARI Project Associate -I recruitment is 07 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Associate -I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. or M.Tech (including Integrated M.Tech 4+2) in Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Plant Biochemistry, or Life Sciences with a 4 or 5-year bachelor's degree. Those with a 3-year bachelor's degree need NET/GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years. Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST and women candidates (5 years) and for OBC candidates (3 years).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate -I position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is ₹31,000/- + HRA per month for NET/GATE qualified candidates, and ₹25,000/- + HRA per month for those without NET/GATE/BET qualifications.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the ICAR IARI Project Associate -I recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Eligible candidates need to send their application in the prescribed proforma along with self-attested scanned copies of documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Email. Candidates need to send their applications to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Associate -I post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial screening of applications followed by an online interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Does ICAR IARI offer any relaxation in age for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, ICAR IARI offers age relaxation for reserved categories. SC/ST and women candidates get a 5-year relaxation, while OBC candidates receive a 3-year relaxation.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the Project Associate -I position?
faq.answer: The Project Associate -I position is on a contractual basis, meaning it is a contract job.
